description: Per-file provenance manifest for all ABC files in the AXIOM reference corpus. Covers all 133 files (119 primary + 14 theory/technical). This is the canonical authenticity and completeness source for analyzer and promotion gate checks.

fields.id: Unique identifier for this file entry
fields.composer: Lowercase composer key: beethoven | schubert | bach | mozart | chopin | brahms
fields.role: primary | theory_only | future_reference — must match corpus-manifest.json composerRoles
fields.catalogNumber: Opus/catalogue number (Op. XX, WoO XX, D. XXX, K. XXX, BWV XXX)
fields.movement: Movement number/label if applicable, else null
fields.instrumentation: solo_piano | string_quartet | piano_arr | solo_keyboard | chamber | etc.
fields.measureStart: First measure number if partial file, else null
fields.measureEnd: Last measure number if partial file, else null
fields.abcPath: Relative path from config/reference-corpus/ to the ABC file
fields.sourceUrl: URL of the original source — required for production promotion gate
fields.sourceLicense: public_domain | CC0 | CC-BY | verified — required for production promotion gate
fields.sourceName: Name of source archive or edition (e.g. IMSLP, OpenScore)
fields.transcriber: Name/handle of the ABC transcriber, or null/unknown
fields.verificationNotes: Notes on verification status or known issues
fields.sha256: SHA-256 content hash of the ABC file for integrity checking
fields.verified: true only when sourceUrl, sourceLicense, sha256, and editorial check are complete
fields.incipitFingerprint: Optional: opening note fingerprint for authenticity guard. openingIntervals: chromatic semitone intervals between first N consecutive non-rest notes. openingPitchClasses: pitch class 0-11 for the first N non-rest notes. minSimilarityThreshold: fraction of intervals that must match (default 0.5). source: verification basis.
